findings.title: POE tables (poe_events / poe_trust_scores / poe_contracts) fully orphaned
findings.summary: Three POE tables with 5 indexes are created on every StateDatabase::new() but no production code reads or writes them. Pure dead schema.

findings.title: experience_replays migration is dead (no Cortex consumer)
findings.summary: migrate_add_experience_replays creates experience_replays + 4 indexes + experiences_vec vec0; nothing reads or writes them anywhere in the tree.

findings.title: MemoryStats struct fully orphaned (re-exported from 3 sites, no consumers)
findings.summary: Defined in state_database/mod.rs and re-exported from database::mod.rs, resilience::mod.rs, and lib.rs:220. Webchat has its own unrelated MemoryStats. No production reader.

findings.title: Entire agent_events Skeleton & Pulse surface unused (9 methods + 7 TYPE_* constants)
findings.summary: All 9 CRUD methods on agent_events (insert_event, bulk_insert_events, get_events_by_task, get_events_since_seq, get_events_in_range, get_structural_events, get_latest_event_seq, delete_events_for_task, get_event_count) have zero production callers. AgentEvent TYPE_* constants likewise unused.

findings.title: TaskStatus::Idle and ::Swapped never produced (only round-trip)
findings.summary: Two of seven TaskStatus variants are documented as Session-as-a-Service but no production path writes them. Accept via from_str_or_default, never written by reconcile or update_task_status.

findings.title: should_auto_resume and needs_resume_confirmation unused
findings.summary: Both AgentTask recovery-decision methods defined + tested but never called in production. Actual recovery is unconditional Running->Interrupted via reconcile_orphaned_tasks.

findings.title: Recursive Sentry fields (recursion_depth, parent_task_id, with_parent_task) are aspirational
findings.summary: Schema columns + struct fields + builder method exist but no code enforces, increments, or reads them. AgentTask::new always sets recursion_depth=0, parent_task_id=None.

findings.title: Shadow Replay recovery fields (checkpoint_snapshot_path, last_tool_call_id) unused
findings.summary: Both fields written by insert_agent_task but never read by any recovery code path. Real recovery uses reconcile_orphaned_tasks which ignores them.

findings.title: memories table + vec0 + FTS5 + triggers dead in state.db
findings.summary: Real memory storage is in memory.db via memory/store/sqlite/. Resilience state.db has duplicate dead schema including memories_vec (vec0 1024-dim), memories_fts, 2 sync triggers, 3 indexes. Triggers never fire (no inserts).

findings.title: 7 tables duplicated from memory.db (compression_sessions / graph_* / daily_insights / dream_status)
findings.summary: compression_sessions, graph_nodes, graph_edges, graph_aliases, memory_entities, daily_insights, dream_status are created in state.db but only ever read/written in memory.db (different file, different backend).

findings.title: AlephError::config used for 136+ DB errors with misleading TOML suggestion
findings.summary: Hardcoded suggestion reads 'Check your configuration file at ~/.aleph/config.toml' but the actual error is a DB connection / FK / serialization failure. memory_events.rs uses AlephError::other (no misleading suggestion) — proving the inconsistency.

findings.title: 3 of 7 agent_tasks CRUD methods unused outside tests
findings.summary: get_tasks_by_session, get_recoverable_tasks, mark_running_as_interrupted have no production callers. The latter two are only invoked internally by reconcile_orphaned_tasks and by tests.

findings.title: 7 of 11 trace methods unused outside tests
findings.summary: bulk_insert_traces, get_last_trace, get_traces_from_step, delete_traces_for_task, get_trace_count, list_trace_tasks, get_trace_by_id. Built for Shadow Replay resume which never materialized.

findings.title: reconcile_orphaned_tasks returns pre-update snapshot (status stale)
findings.summary: Returned AgentTask Vec has status=Running (snapshot) while DB has status=Interrupted. Current callers don't read task.status, so harmless today; footgun for future callers.

findings.title: mark_running_as_interrupted doesn't set completed_at (state-machine inconsistency)
findings.summary: update_task_status sets completed_at for Completed/Failed. The bulk path Running->Interrupted leaves completed_at NULL, indistinguishable from 'started but never finished'. Combines poorly with finding R-L3.

findings.title: Module name promises reconnect/retry/backoff that does not exist
findings.summary: Per grep: src/resilience/ contains zero retry/backoff/reconnect/circuit-breaker code. Module is purely persistence + types. Audit brief's expectation comes from aspirational doc comments in types.rs.
